steps.body: PLACEHOLDER: this chapter is still being written, and Snake ToolBox is not going to pretend otherwise. Here is where object-oriented programming arrives: you will feel WHY classes exist by hitting the pain of an outgrown flat program first, then build your first class (class, __init__, attributes, methods, instances, and self). The full version is on the way. For now this page is an honest signpost of where the road goes next, not the lesson itself.
